title: Pie chart
description:
A pie chart shows each row's share: `label_column` names the slices, `value_column`
sizes them (positive values only). The default style is one proportional bar with a
legend; `renderer: circle` draws a round pie. See `:help dbdash-chart-types`.

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: bar (default): colors by position
show.description:
One bar split in proportion, the legend under it with the value and the percentage.
`colors` as a list colors the slices in order.

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: renderer: circle, palette: tableau
show.description:
A round pie on a braille canvas, the legend beside it (`legend.position: bottom` puts
it under); `palette: tableau` instead of the colorscheme's colors.

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: donut, format
show.description:
`donut: 0.6` leaves a hole of 60% of the radius (Chart.js `cutout`) and writes the
total in it; `format` is the Python format of the values ("{:,} k").

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: half, legend: bottom
show.description:
`half: true` draws the upper half (Chart.js `circumference: 180`, a gauge-like pie);
the legend goes `bottom`.

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: sort, top, other_label
show.description:
`sort: desc` orders the slices by size, `top: 3` keeps the three largest and puts the
rest in one slice named by `other_label` (default "Other").

query.sql:
SELECT 'Engineering' AS dept, 420 AS budget UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 310
UNION ALL SELECT 'Marketing', 180 UNION ALL SELECT 'Research', 260
UNION ALL SELECT 'Support', 90 UNION ALL SELECT 'HR', 40

show.title: colors by name, legend parts
show.description:
`colors` as a mapping colors slices by name; `show_labels`, `show_values` and
`show_percentages` pick the legend's columns.
